name: Hex

Canonical action: Apply {weak} Weak and {vulnerable} Vulnerable. Exhaust. [{"op":"applyStatus","target":"enemy","status":"weak","stacks":2},{"op":"applyStatus","target":"enemy","status":"vulnerable","stacks":2}]. Lore/mood: Sign scratched upon a door.

The hamlets mark it on houses where someone marked burns slowly within, to keep it from coming out. They learned the sign from the Chapel, which set it upon the houses of the unmarked before the Decree.

The hamlets call it fair to use it the other way round.. Illustrate that specific action or concept clearly in a grounded ruined medieval dark fantasy world. For rogue cards use a weathered hooded agile rogue and correct weapons; equipment technique must depict the named weapon (unarmed means empty hands, bow means bow and arrow, staff means a long magical staff, sceptre a short ritual focus). Single coherent scene, anatomically correct hands and physically plausible weapons. Rich painted material detail, dramatic readable lighting, ash, old stone, worn iron, muted earth with appropriate restrained magical color. Composition portrait 2:3, 1024x1536. Main focal action below the upper third, with ample detailed background/sky/ruins ABOVE and around it for user repositioning and mouse cropping. Avoid subject clipping and excessive closeup. No card frame, text, letters, numbers, icons, UI, parchment, watermarks, or collage. Not graphic gore; show combat through movement, sparks and spell effects. Final production artwork.
